Introduction to Computing.title: Introduction to Computing
Introduction to Computing.content:
Introduction to Computing

Computing is the use of computers to process, store, and communicate information.

Theme

Students learn about the role of technology in education, business, and daily life.

Computer Fundamentals.title: Computer Fundamentals
Computer Fundamentals.content:
Computer Fundamentals

Basic computer knowledge includes hardware, software, memory, and processing concepts.

Purpose

This foundation helps learners understand how computers work and how systems are connected.

Number Systems.title: Number Systems
Number Systems.content:
Number Systems

Decimal, binary, and hexadecimal are common systems used in computing and logic design.

Logic and Flowcharts.title: Logic and Flowcharts
Logic and Flowcharts.content:
Logic and Flowcharts

Flowcharts help explain algorithm steps visually and make problem solving easier.

Use

Students learn to plan solutions before writing code.

Internet and Communication.title: Internet and Communication
Internet and Communication.content:
Internet and Communication

Communication systems and internet tools allow people to exchange information quickly and efficiently.

Digital Citizenship.title: Digital Citizenship
Digital Citizenship.content:
Digital Citizenship

Responsible use of digital tools includes respecting privacy, using technology safely, and preventing cyber misuse.
